svg.title: Topic mix of ChatGPT messages in Norway, and the split of the rise in women's share
svg.desc: Top panel: each topic's share of all messages per month, July 2024 to September 2026. Writing falls and practical guidance rises. Bottom panel: the rise in women's share from the first to the last 3 months, split into a within-topic part, a mix part and an unexplained part. All values are in output/03_measured_mix.csv and output/03_measured_mix_topics.csv.
svg.text: Writing shrank, but the rise still came from within topics
ChatGPT messages in Norway, July 2024 to September 2026
Each topic's share of all messages
The rise from the first to the last 3 months, in percentage points
Top: OpenAI's topic mix, rescaled to sum to 100 % each month. Other three: multimedia, self-expression, other/unknown.
Bottom: all seven topics. Data: share_of_messages_by_topic_country_month.csv, norway_gender_topics_monthly.csv.
